text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Gosh, I've really done it this time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
McQueen's injury seems to be more serious
than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'll be getting a proper diagnosis soon,
but
it seems I'll have to give
up on the
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No need to look so glum. It's unfortunate,
but I still have my third
consecutive win in
the Tenno Sho to work toward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The race means a lot to me, and if I'm to
accomplish this feat, I must
focus on
recovery above all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This does mean I'll be unable to train
with
you, but I'm sure the other
team members
will fill my place.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Our trainer, your teammates—myself
included—we all have high
hopes for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So please,
show us a race that will light a
fire in our hearts.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Okay... I'll run with everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Anyhow,
I'll be fine with just Trainer
here. Rice, you'd best get
back to your
training.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'll check in on you again later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She heads out with determination written
on her face. Perhaps she
was roused by
McQueen's words.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing her now, I sense a mysterious
power. One that will pull us all
forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's right. Having such a hard worker in
their midst has done
wonders for the rest
of the team.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
I'll need to work just as hard as her
if I'm to make a full
recovery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Filling the hole left by McQueen's absence
brings the entire team
together in helping
Rice train.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Just keep following,
just keep following...

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Okay Rice, start following me now.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Got it. Follow the leader.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Rice is so good at this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hard at work,
I see. Looks like her training
is a boon to the entire
team.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You can say that again. My legs are
shaking like a newborn goat's.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, now that you can't exercise, you
better watch that weight. I saw
those extra
helpings of dessert yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Y-you saw that?! Blame the pudding for
being excessively flavorsome!
I've done
nothing wrong!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Desserts aside, Rice is really coming into
form.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you and the others. Y'all being
there pushes her to work
harder.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: If anything, seeing her work so hard gives me strength.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Welp, I'm gonna go run my heart
out. Go lie down or
something!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hey! ...Ugh,
she's just rubbing it in because
she knows how much I'm
itching to run
again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With everyone working together, training
proceeds smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ooh... I'm so nervous...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Learn to revel in this feeling,
nerves
and all.

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Rice,
you've got this! Just think of all the
training we did!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah... I worked hard for this.
I'm going
to have fun, and...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And get my win against Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That's what I like to hear!

text_block_list.name: Sincere Umamusume
text_block_list.text: We'll be cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thanks. Okay, well, here goes!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Got it! Follow the leader!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to win. She last spoke those words
to me back on the ferris
wheel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now it's time for her to prove how much
she really wants it.
